summary: List of private AnsibleModule methods removed in ansible-core 2.11 and their public replacements in ansible.module_utils.common.validation, such as check_mutually_exclusive, check_required_if and check_type_* functions.
questions: Is there a public check_type_bool function?
Which private AnsibleModule methods have no public replacement?
How do I call check_mutually_exclusive directly?

answer_card.title: Public replacements for AnsibleModule._check_*
answer_card.answer_md:
Use `ansible.module_utils.common.validation`:

| Removed private method | Public function |
|---|---|
| `_check_mutually_exclusive` | `check_mutually_exclusive` |
| `_check_required_arguments` / `_by` / `_if` / `_one_of` / `_together` | `check_required_arguments` / `check_required_by` / `check_required_if` / `check_required_one_of` / `check_required_together` |
| `_check_type_<t>` (bits, bool, bytes, dict, float, int, jsonarg, list, path, raw, str) | `check_type_<t>` |
| `_count_terms` | `count_terms` |

No public equivalent: `_check_argument_types`, `_check_argument_values`, `_check_arguments`, `_get_wanted_type`, `_handle_aliases`, `_handle_no_log_values`, `_handle_options`, `_set_defaults`, `_set_fallbacks`; use `ArgumentSpecValidator.validate()`.
